tasks.name: Stash zoom/pan WIP and create migration branch

tasks.name: Add migration plan and dogfood task list to docs/
tasks.description:
Add these, so the migration can be run with `/atm:do-task` and `/atm:loop-tasks` and watched via `cd docs && python3 -m http.server 8000`:

tasks.name: Scaffold dashboard/ with Vite, Svelte 5 and TypeScript
tasks.description:
Create `dashboard/` (**not shipped**; the plugin source is `./plugin`) with:

tasks.name: Single-file build to dashboard/dist with version injection
tasks.description:

tasks.name: Configure Vitest with coverage and testing-library
tasks.description:
Set up Vitest (jsdom) with `@testing-library/svelte` and `@vitest/coverage-v8`.
- Coverage threshold: **90% lines on `src/lib/**`**.
- Tests live in `dashboard/tests/unit/`.
- Add `npm test` and `npm run test:coverage`.
- Include one trivial passing test to prove the setup.

tasks.name: Playwright harness with legacy and svelte projects
tasks.description:
### Freeze the baseline
Freeze the current shipped dashboard as `dashboard/tests/legacy/tasks-dashboard.v0.4.0.html`.

### `playwright.config.ts`
- Chromium only, fixed viewport, a `webServer` serving a static dir.
- **Two projects running the same specs**, selected via a per-project `baseURL`/path: `legacy` (the frozen file) and `svelte` (`dashboard/dist/tasks-dashboard.html`).
- `snapshotPathTemplate` must **omit the project name**, so `svelte` compares against legacy screenshots.

### Helpers
`tests/e2e/helpers.ts` with:
- `useFixture(page, name)`, which serves `tests/fixtures/<name>.json` for `**/tasks.json` via `page.route` (and can swap the response or return 404);
- an auto fixture that **fails the test on any non-localhost request**.

Add `npm run test:e2e`.

tasks.name: Lint, format, svelte-check, npm scripts and root CLAUDE.md
tasks.description:
### Tools
Add ESLint (flat config, `eslint-plugin-svelte`, `typescript-eslint`), Prettier (+ `prettier-plugin-svelte`) and `svelte-check`.

### Scripts
- `dev`, `build`, `test`, `test:coverage`, `test:e2e`
- `check`: `svelte-check` + `eslint` + `prettier --check`
- `verify`: `check` + `test` + `build` + `test:e2e`

### `CLAUDE.md`
Add a repo-root `CLAUDE.md` describing the dev workflow, the plugin vs dashboard split, and that `plugin/templates/tasks-dashboard.html` is a **build artifact** (after cutover).

tasks.name: Create tasks.json test fixtures
tasks.description: In `dashboard/tests/fixtures/`: - `empty.json` - `minimal.json`: 1 task - `standard.json`: all 7 types × 5 statuses, 3 phases, deps, `use_cases` / `requirements` / `files`, `created_at` / `updated_at` timestamps - `cycle.json`: a dependency cycle - `edge-cases.json`: unknown type and status, a dependency on a missing ID, tasks without timestamps, very long names, unicode, HTML like `bold` in name and description - `no-meta.json`: no `meta` block Add `tests/fixtures/generate-large.mjs`, which **deterministically** writes `large-90.json` (90 tasks, wide graph, ~40 done, 1 `in_progress`), and commit its output.

tasks.name: Regression specs: load, stats, timeline
tasks.description:
`tests/e2e/load.spec.ts` and `stats.spec.ts`, **green on the legacy project**.

### Load
- The page title and `#dashboard-title` use `meta.project`.
- The subtitle counts tasks and phases.
- `no-meta` falls back to *Task Dashboard*.
- A 404 for `tasks.json` shows the *Failed to load tasks.json* box with `python3 -m http.server` instructions.

### Stats
- *Total* / *Done* / *In Progress* / *Todo* numbers.
- The *Blocked* card only when blocked > 0.
- Per-type count cards; progress %.

### Timeline
- Shown only when tasks have timestamps.
- Bucket count clamped to 4–16.
- Start/end date labels.
- A tooltip appears on bar hover.

tasks.name: Regression specs: filters and task cards
tasks.description:
`tests/e2e/filters.spec.ts` and `cards.spec.ts`, **green on legacy**.

### Filters
- Generated phase/type/status buttons (`.filter-btn[data-filter][data-value]`).
- Status order `todo, in_progress, done, blocked, skipped`; capitalized labels.
- Multi-select is **OR within a group and AND across groups**.
- *All* clears the group; active classes stay in sync.
- *N of M shown* text.
- The empty-result message in both the card grid and the graph.

### Cards
- `.task-card[data-id]` with phase/type/status badges.
- *needs:* dependency links scroll to and highlight the target card.
- UC and requirement tags.

tasks.name: Regression specs: detail panel and dependency graph
tasks.description:
`tests/e2e/detail.spec.ts` and `graph.spec.ts`, **green on legacy**.

### Detail
- Opens from a card name and from a graph node (`#detail-overlay.open`).
- Shows description, UCs, requirements, timestamps, files.
- *Depends On* and *Required By* entries navigate to the other task.
- Closes via the × button, an overlay click and `Escape`.

### Graph
- One node per filtered task; the edge count matches visible dependencies.
- `#graph-badge` says *N tasks*.
- `cycle.json` still renders every node.
- A header click collapses and expands the graph.

tasks.name: Regression specs: reload, auto-refresh, edge cases
tasks.description:
`tests/e2e/refresh.spec.ts` and `edge-cases.spec.ts`, **green on legacy**.

### Refresh
- `#reload-btn` re-fetches and re-renders after the fixture response is swapped.
- `#auto-refresh-check` plus `#auto-refresh-interval` polls on the configured interval (use `page.clock`).
- Active filters survive a reload.

### Edge cases
- Unknown type/status render with fallback styles.
- A dependency on a missing ID does not crash.
- Long names are truncated to 22 chars in graph nodes.

### XSS divergence
A test asserting task text is rendered as **literal text (not HTML)** is marked `test.fail()` for the legacy project only, with a comment explaining the svelte port fixes it.

tasks.name: Visual baseline screenshots from legacy

- Visual specs must stay stable (decide and document whether they run with the marker seen).

tasks.name: Kanban model: columns, ordering, readiness, next up
tasks.description:
Add `src/lib/kanban.ts`.

### `buildBoard(tasks, allTasks, { showSkipped, statusFilter })`
Returns the columns *Todo*, *In Progress*, *Blocked*, *Done* (+ *Skipped* when shown, + *Other* for unknown statuses when present), each with a count and ordered cards:
- **Todo:** ready first, then by phase/id;
- **In Progress:** by `started_at` (fallback `updated_at`), newest first;
- **Done:** by `completed_at` (fallback `updated_at`), newest first;
- **Blocked:** by phase/id.

With a status filter, only matching columns are returned.

### Readiness and next up
- `readiness(task, taskMap)` → ready, or the list of unfinished dependency ids (deps outside the file count as unfinished).
- `nextUp(allTasks)` implements **exactly the loop-tasks selection rule**: status `todo`, all deps done, lowest phase, then lowest id.

### Tests
Unit tests, including a test that `nextUp` matches the rule described in `plugin/skills/loop-tasks/SKILL.md`.

tasks.name: Progress test fixture
Forecast model
tasks.description:
Implement `docs/dashboard-v2-requirements.md` section 3 in `src/lib/forecast.ts`:

- Done phases report their last completion date.
- Fewer than 3 timed completions → *"not enough history"*.
